description: Add support for applying custom encoders to WebSocket connection parameters in the tRPC client. Currently, connection parameters are sent without proper encoding, which can cause compatibility issues when the server expects encoded parameters. This feature should ensure that connection parameters respect the specified encoder configuration.
functional_requirements: Modify the WebSocket client to apply the configured encoder when building connection parameters
Ensure the encoder is applied consistently across all WebSocket connection initialization paths
Maintain backward compatibility for clients that don't specify an encoder
Update the WebSocket connection utility functions to handle encoded parameters properly
Add appropriate error handling for encoding failures during connection parameter preparation
